full_prompt_en: The image is a square stylized storybook illustration of an adult and a child standing hand in hand at the edge of a glowing city at night. They are seen from behind near the lower center. The taller figure wears a dark green coat and narrow trousers; the smaller figure has a rounded black bob and a burgundy dress. Both face a dense maze of stacked buildings, pointed roofs, arches, and tall narrow towers. A pale yellow moon hangs high slightly right of center, partly tucked among the blue-green structures. Many small windows and round streetlamps emit warm yellow light throughout the city. Bare dark trees stand along the left and right edges, their thin branches reaching over the architectural pattern. The near pavement is a mosaic of cool blue and gray rectangular tiles with warm light spilling across it near the figures' feet. The city has compressed storybook perspective: buildings overlap at different scales without obeying a single strict vanishing point. Shapes are simplified into tall blocks, cones, arches, and rectangles, but slight brush texture and mottled color keep them from looking digital. The palette is layered teal, navy, slate blue, muted peach, warm cream, and small orange-yellow glows. Deep foreground silhouettes make the two figures readable without facial detail. Light seems to come from the moon and many small lamps rather than one physical source. The scene is busy in the distance yet calm in the foreground. The adult and child provide a human path into the city, and their stillness lets the viewer explore the luminous pattern. The effect is whimsical and gently mysterious, built from layered color, tiny lights, protective dark framing trees, and the quiet shared gaze toward a larger imagined world.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形风格化故事书插画，一名成人和一名孩子在夜色中发亮的城市边缘牵手站着。他们从背后入镜，位于下方中央附近。较高的人穿深绿外套与窄裤；较小的人留圆黑短发，穿酒红裙。两人面对密集层叠的楼、尖顶、拱与高窄塔。浅黄月亮高悬于中央稍右，局部藏在蓝绿结构间。城中许多小窗和圆街灯发暖黄光。裸深树立在左右边缘，细枝伸过建筑花纹。近处铺地由冷蓝与灰矩形地砖组成，暖光在人物脚旁洒开。城市采用压缩的故事书透视：楼以不同尺度重叠，不服从单一严格消失点。形状简化为高块、锥、拱和矩形，少许刷痕与斑驳色彩使其不似数字纯面。配色层叠青绿、海军蓝、板岩蓝、暗桃、暖奶油与小橙黄亮点。深前景剪影使两个人即使没有面部细节也易读。光像来自月亮和许多小灯，而非一个物理光源。远处忙碌，前景却平静。成人与孩子提供进入城市的人尺度路径，他们静立让观者探索发光花纹。效果奇趣且温和神秘，由层叠色彩、小灯、护框般的深树和两人朝向更大想象世界的安静共同目光构成。
style_prompt_en: Storybook illustration layers simplified towers, arches, small windows, and tree silhouettes into a dense but readable nocturnal pattern. Teal, navy, slate blue, muted peach, and cream form a cool base, punctuated by many small warm yellow glows. Perspective is compressed and imaginative, with overlapping scales rather than one rigid vanishing point. Dark foreground shapes provide a calm anchor against intricate luminous distance. A moonlike circle or other large pale disk can balance repeated tiny lights. Soft painted grain and mottled color prevent geometric forms from becoming sterile. The effect is whimsical, protective, and gently mysterious, guiding the eye from quiet near silhouettes into a rich imagined space.
style_prompt_zh: 故事书插画把简化塔、拱、小窗与树剪影层叠成密而可读的夜间花纹。青绿、海军蓝、板岩蓝、暗桃与奶油色为冷底，许多小暖黄光点散布其中。透视压缩且富想象，尺度重叠，不依靠一个僵硬消失点。深前景形状在繁复发亮远处前提供平静锚点。月般圆或其他大片浅盘可平衡重复小灯。柔和绘画颗粒与斑驳色彩防止几何形变得冰冷。效果奇趣、具有庇护感且温和神秘，引导视线从安静近剪影进入丰盛想象空间。
theme_en: An adult and child standing together before a glowing geometric city at night
theme_zh: 一名成人与孩子并立于夜间发亮的几何城市前
name: Joey Chou
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
